title: Signature Math Mapping — Hash Digest (SHA-256)
description: How the Signature bitstring reads as Hash Digest (SHA-256) (Cryptography). SHA-256 maps any input to a fixed 256-bit (64-hex-character) fingerprint. Changing even one bit of input changes the digest completely.

fields.name: Hash Digest (SHA-256)
fields.system: SHA-256 maps any input to a fixed 256-bit (64-hex-character) fingerprint. Changing even one bit of input changes the digest completely.
fields.mapping: Hash the canonical Signature record — coordinates in the Document 1 reconstruction order, UTF-8 encoded — to fingerprint the geometry. Publish the digest beside the record: anyone can re-hash and verify the mark is unaltered.
apply: 1. Write the canonical record: coordinates in reconstruction order, 2 decimals, comma-separated, UTF-8.
2. Run SHA-256 over those exact bytes.
3. Publish the 64-hex-character digest with the record.
4. Verifiers re-hash the same bytes and compare digests.

run_steps: Confirm every line prints PASS and the run ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.

march: March to a million in progress — connector record, marching toward the 1,000,000-record target.
